## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Backend typecheck/build/tests pass when applicable.
- [ ] Frontend typecheck/build/tests pass when applicable.
- [ ] Manual browser testing completed for user-facing changes.
- [ ] WebRTC behavior tested on the target device/browser matrix when media/signaling changed.

## Security & configuration

- [ ] No secrets or private user data are included.
- [ ] Firebase/CORS/auth/rules changes are documented.
- [ ] Environment-variable changes are reflected in `.env.example` files.

## Notes

List known limitations, migration/configuration steps, screenshots, or follow-up work.
